company: PT Kimia Farma Tbk (IDX: KAEF) — Bio Farma group
sector: Pharmaceutical manufacturing, distribution and retail — corporate / investor-relations site
data_coverage: 15 URLs sampled of 217 unique sitemap URLs (267 <loc> entries); 4 of the 15 were empty soft-404 shells, so 11 real pages
overall_rating: Poor — strong brand and HSTS/CSP security headers, but a broken CMS layer: any URL returns 200, 72% of the sitemap 404s, and every page shares one meta description

technical_seo.meta_titles: Pattern 'Kimia Farma | <menu label>' — homepage 'Kimia Farma | BUMN Farmasi Terbesar di Indonesia' (48 chars). 4 of 15 sampled pages have the bare title 'Kimia Farma |' (empty shells). Berita Korporat and Kabar TJSL both use the English 'Kimia Farma | Journal'. Contact page title is an 85-char sentence ('Hubungi kami melalui berbagai cara mudah...')
technical_seo.meta_descriptions: One hard-coded sentence ('...didirikan sejak tahun 1817.') on 14 of 15 pages; the one news article sampled has the description '-' (a single hyphen)
technical_seo.og_tags: Partial — tags exist but are template constants: og:title 'Kimia Farma' and og:url 'https://www.kimiafarma.co.id' on every non-article page, so every share card points to the homepage; og:site_name is set to a URL instead of the brand; fb:app_id and google-site-verification are empty strings
technical_seo.h1_tags:
Homepage has no H1 (its top heading is an H2 'Integrasi Layanan Farmasi Dari Hulu Ke Hilir'). 4 inner pages render an empty

. The article page repeats its title as both H1 and H2
technical_seo.h2_h3_hierarchy: Template uses H5/H6 for layout: 23 H5s on the homepage (section labels such as 'ANAK USAHA', 'NEED HELP?') and an H6 for the phone number '1-500-255'. Subsidiary card reads 'MARIN LISA' while the menu says 'PT Marin Liza Farmasi'
technical_seo.image_alt_text: The Bio Farma group logo (logo_bio.png) has no alt attribute on every page (one template fix clears 15 of the 15 counted cases). A further 15 content images use alt="", including the 7 channel icons on the Contact Center page. Promo banners are labelled 'Promotion' / 'Banner'
technical_seo.schema_markup: NONE — no JSON-LD or microdata on any sampled page. Missing: Organization (legalName, tickerSymbol KAEF, parentOrganization Bio Farma, subOrganization for Phapros, KFTD, KF Apotek, KF Diagnostika, SIL, KFSP), NewsArticle on /read/ pages, ContactPoint for contact center 1-500-255
technical_seo.canonical_urls: Self-referencing, but also on the empty shells, so each junk URL declares itself canonical
technical_seo.soft_404: CRITICAL — any path under /id/ returns HTTP 200 with the empty template (/id/halaman-tidak-ada-xyz → 200, title 'Kimia Farma |'). /id/profil, /id/profil-perusahaan, /id/sejarah and /id/corporate-info/company-structure are such shells, while the real history page is /id/sejarah-kimia-farma
technical_seo.sitemap: Present but broken: 267 <loc> entries, 217 unique. 96 use /id-ID/ and 97 use /en-GB/ prefixes; the site only serves /id/ and /en/, so those 193 URLs (the whole news archive) 404, although the same slugs load under /id/read/. Also 17 entries of 'https://www.kimiafarma.co.id//', one '/6/bisnis', one malformed '/id/https://eproc.kimiafarma.co.id/...'. Not declared in robots.txt
technical_seo.international: Two URL trees (/id/, /en/), no hreflang. <html lang="en"> on every page, including Indonesian ones. /en homepage still has the Indonesian title. English articles also resolve under /id/read/ (e.g. /id/read/kimia-farma-launches-15-new-pharmacy-outlets → 200), so duplicates exist across language prefixes
technical_seo.analytics: Meta Pixel on inner pages only, not the homepage. No GA4 / GTM detected — a listed company with no web analytics in the HTML
technical_seo.ssl: Yes — HSTS max-age 31536000 with includeSubDomains, strict CSP, X-Frame-Options. Leaks a debug header 'X-Debug-HTACCESS: Active'
technical_seo.mobile: Viewport tag present; Bootstrap 5. Mobile menu omits PT Marin Liza Farmasi and PT Lucas Djaja, which the desktop menu lists
technical_seo.platform: Custom PHP on CodeIgniter (ci_session cookie), Apache, theme path /themes/front_site/
technical_seo.content_rendering: Homepage KPI counters ship as '0 +' in the HTML (FASILITAS PRODUKSI, OUTLET FARMASI, JUTA PELANGGAN...) and are filled in by JS, so non-JS crawlers and snippets see zeros
technical_seo.cookie_banner: Not detected — Meta Pixel fires on inner pages without consent; UU PDP (Law 27/2022) gap

content_seo.keyword_strategy: No targeting. Titles are menu labels, meta descriptions are one constant, and the site is a corporate/IR hub. Consumer product and pharmacy intent is served by subsidiary domains (Kimia Farma Apotek, Phapros), so this site should own brand, investor, corporate-news and pharmacovigilance queries, not 'apotek terdekat'
captured_keywords: bahan baku obat (BBO) Kimia Farma Sungwun Pharmacopia
content_seo.pages: 11 real pages in the sample. Word counts include the ~250-word mega-menu that is rendered twice (desktop + mobile), so the reported 570 average is inflated; the empty shells score 210+ words from chrome alone
content_seo.blog: News archive (/id/read/<slug>) exists and is reachable from Berita Korporat, but its sitemap URLs 404 and the article sampled has a '-' meta description
content_seo.entity_rich_content: Rich facts sit in plain text only: founded 1817, 49 distribution branches, >1,300 outlets, 400 clinics, 24,000 outlets / 23 million customers, contact center 1-500-255. None of it is in structured data

competitive_seo_position: Brand queries are safe. Informational and IR queries ('saham KAEF', 'laporan keuangan Kimia Farma') compete with IDX, news portals and stock apps, which are likely to outrank a site whose news sitemap is 72% dead (no ranking data measured). The realistic win is recovering the ~190 news articles through a correct sitemap and making the IR pages indexable with unique titles
quick_wins: Return real 404s for unknown slugs; 301 /id/sejarah and /id/profil to /id/sejarah-kimia-farma and /id/profil-perusahaan (to the real content page)
Regenerate sitemap.xml with /id/ and /en/ prefixes, drop the '//' and '/6/bisnis' rows, then add robots.txt with a Sitemap: line
Make og:url, og:title and meta description page-specific in the front_site template (one template edit fixes 14 pages)
Add alt="Bio Farma" to logo_bio.png in the shared header
